collections.name: The Bakhiya Edit
collections.description: Shadow-work embroidery, stitched from the reverse so the design falls in soft silhouette on the front.

collections.name: Jaali Lattice
collections.description: Hand-pulled net work, opened thread by thread to let the fabric breathe.

collections.name: Murri & Phanda
collections.description: Raised rice-grain and knot stitches, worked for texture you can feel as well as see.

collections.name: Taipchi Outline
collections.description: The foundational running stitch, used for fine outlines and everyday-wear pieces.

products.name: Safed Bakhiya Kurta
products.description: Our signature piece: dense bakhiya shadow-work across the yoke, worked entirely from the reverse of the fabric so the motif falls in soft silhouette on the front. Cut in breathable mulmul cotton for everyday wear.
products.care: Hand wash cold with mild detergent. Dry flat in shade. Iron on reverse over a muslin cloth.
products.artisanNote: Hand-embroidered by artisans in Lucknow. Approx. 30 hours of bakhiya work per piece.

products.name: Gulabi Jaali Anarkali
products.description: A floor-sweeping anarkali with hand-pulled jaali lattice across the bodice — thread drawn open, strand by strand, to let the fabric breathe. Finished with a delicate taipchi border.
products.care: Dry clean only. Store folded in muslin to protect the jaali work.
products.artisanNote: Jaali work is reserved for our most senior artisans — it takes years to learn to open the weave without tearing it.

products.name: Murri Work Straight Suit
products.description: A 3-piece straight suit set with rice-grain murri knots forming the floral buta, paired with matching dupatta and straight-cut pants.
products.care: Hand wash separately. Do not wring — press out water gently and dry flat.
products.artisanNote: Every murri knot is tied by hand — this suit carries roughly 4,000 individual knots.

products.name: Phanda Buta Saree
products.description: A featherweight chiffon saree scattered with phanda knot butas, paired with a matching bakhiya-edged blouse piece.
products.care: Dry clean recommended. Iron on low heat over a cloth.
products.artisanNote: Comes with an unstitched blouse piece finished in matching phanda work.

products.name: Taipchi Everyday Kurta
products.description: Our most-loved everyday kurta — a fine taipchi running-stitch outline traces a simple floral border at the neckline and hem. Easy to wear, easy to care for.
products.care: Machine washable on gentle cycle. Tumble dry low.
products.artisanNote: Taipchi is the first stitch every chikankari artisan learns — simple, but unmistakably hand-done.

products.name: Keel Kangan Palazzo Set
products.description: A relaxed kurta and palazzo set with keel kangan's raised, caterpillar-like stitch bordering the sleeves and hem.
products.care: Hand wash cold. Dry flat in shade.
products.artisanNote: Keel kangan is one of the more time-intensive raised stitches, reserved for statement borders.

products.name: Bakhiya Shadow-Work Dupatta
products.description: A sheer organza dupatta with a continuous bakhiya border — the translucent shadow effect is most visible in this weight of fabric.
products.artisanNote: Organza shows bakhiya's signature 'shadow' more clearly than any other fabric we work with.

products.name: Jaali Work Blouse
products.description: A fitted blouse with a jaali lattice yoke, designed to pair with our sarees or stand alone with a simple skirt.
products.artisanNote: Unlined at the yoke by design, so the jaali lattice catches the light.

products.name: Ghas Patti Men's Kurta
products.description: A men's straight kurta with ghas patti's grass-leaf stitch bordering the placket, a quieter chikankari statement for everyday wear.
products.artisanNote: Ghas patti's graduated V-stitches are worked entirely on the right side of the fabric.

products.name: Murri Work Lehenga Set
products.description: A statement occasion lehenga with dense murri work across the bodice and a bakhiya-bordered dupatta, fully lined.
products.care: Dry clean only. Store flat, folded in muslin.
products.artisanNote: Our most labour-intensive piece — over 80 hours of combined murri and bakhiya work.

products.name: Hool Detail Kurta
products.description: Delicate hool eyelet stitches form the flower centres across a simple taipchi buta, punched and worked by hand.
products.care: Hand wash cold. Dry flat in shade.
products.artisanNote: Each hool eyelet is punched and bound by hand — no two are perfectly identical.

products.name: Bijli Work Saree
products.description: Bijli's lightning-bolt zigzag stitch borders the pallu of this silk chiffon saree, paired with an unstitched bakhiya blouse piece.
products.artisanNote: Bijli is among the rarer stitches still practised — few artisans still take it on.
